Atarah Banquet: A name you can trust for all your celebrations.
We recently hosted our son’s first birthday here, and we cannot stop praising this venue. Below is our honest and detailed review:

From my very first enquiry call, I was introduced to Ms. Mamta Jain, the main coordinator for our event. Mamta is someone you can share ideas with, and she will make them happen. Kudos to her for being patient and supportive through every call, message, and in-person meeting.

We opted for the Gold package (veg and non-veg), which included:

• 2 welcome drinks
• 2–3 starters
• 3 main course dishes
• 2 types of rice
• 1 dal dish
• 3 varieties of Indian breads
• 3 desserts
• 1 ice cream

We also added a Pan counter at a nominal cost. The best part of Atarah’s packages is the flexibility—you can customize everything to your preferences. For example, although the package included a Chinese dish, we replaced it with a Chaat counter (3 dishes), which turned out to be a fantastic choice.

Our menu selections:

• Welcome drinks: Watermelon cooler (mojito) and Guava chilli
• Starters (10/10):• Veg: Cheese corn balls, Veg spring rolls (not on the menu, but Atarah graciously obliged)
• Non-veg: Chicken chilli, Chicken tikka

• Main course (10/10):• Rice: Jeera rice, Dum biryani (veg & non-veg)
• Dal fry
• Veg: Tawa bhaji, Paneer lababdar, Dum aloo
• Non-veg: Chicken kadai, Chicken Afghani, Mutton sukha

• Indian breads (10/10): Puri, Butter roti, Garlic naan
• Desserts (10/10): Aamras, Angoor basundi, Rabdi jalebi• Special mention: The Aamras was the highlight—every guest went back for seconds!

• Ice cream (9/10): Kulfi slice
• Chaat (10/10): Pani puri, Katori chaat, Ragda patties
• Pan counter (10/10)

The package also included papad, pickle, mukhwas, and mineral water (200 ml).

We added activities like caricature and face painting. While the services were enjoyable, one regret was that the caricature artists left after two hours despite being booked for 200 guests. Unfortunately, even we—the hosts—didn’t get our portraits done.

Aside from this minor hiccup, everything else was flawless. From decorations (lights, stage, hall, seating) to music, food, and service, Atarah delivered perfection. Both Ms. Mamta and Mr. Jayesh coordinated with us until the very end, ensuring the event ran smoothly.

Final verdict:
Atarah Banquets exceeded our expectations and made our son’s first birthday truly memorable. We wholeheartedly recommend them to friends and family.
